notes: Arrange advances course 1 twice (0 -> 2), then one 上一学时 click updates student_course (1,24) progress 2 -> 1 (net 0 -> 1 in the before/after dump). Course 1 is used because 上一学时 clamps at zero and the only other seeded enrollment (course 4) is a completed course absent from the selected-courses page. expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). The schema has no volatile columns (no timestamps/counters): every seeded date is fixed in the dump and the flows fill any date input explicitly, so ignore_columns is empty. All six tables are listed so the capture tooling can warn about any change outside the spec. Shiro sessions live in memory, not in the DB — there is no session table to exclude.
